newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Fahey confident on work reforms.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Fahey confident on work reforms.

text.p: Australian Acting Treasurer John Fahey said on Monday he was confident workplace reform would occur before the end of the year.
"I'm confident that we will see significant reform in the workplace area before the year is out," Fahey told reporters.
He said Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith was in constant discussions with the Australian Democrats over the government's Workplace Relations Bill.
He said the sooner those discussions were concluded the better it would be for the Australian economy.

"The sooner the Senate passes that (the bill) to give flexibility to the workplace to determine their own outcomes in a sensible pragmatic way and in a mutually beneficial way, the better the Australian community will be," Fahey said.
Fahey also said he expected employment growth before the end of the year. "We are confident that will occur and we will see that as the year unfolds."
